integrity.closest_literature_scope: The 2020 work proves the special cubic singular loci, while the 2021 edge-ring result gives global affine class groups; neither publishes the all-point Zariski local rank stratification.
integrity.finite_verification_basis: Exact Smith normal forms; squarefree monomial ideal intersection membership; zero-pattern enumeration in the bundled verifier.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record of Reyes--Tatakis--Thoma arXiv:1002.2045 gives v1 2010-02-10 09:20:55 UTC and MSC listing beginning 14M25.
integrity.infinite_proof_basis: All-m proof in RESULT.md, not finite enumeration.
integrity.ownership_basis: The primary graph-toric-ideals literature arXiv:1002.2045 and arXiv:1210.1950 both list MSC 14M25 first; later references are supporting literature.
integrity.proof_basis: Primitive even-cycle graph-incidence lattice kernel, squarefree radical Jacobian identity, codimension-three normality, Nagata divisor-class localization, total-unimodular complete bipartite relation matrix, exact maximization over projective zero patterns.

scientific_limitations: Only complex projective toric edge varieties of simple even cycles C_{2m} for m>=2 are classified.
The class groups are Zariski local Weil-divisor class groups, not the global edge-ring class group or completed-local analogues.
The singular-line arrangement for the cubic m=3 is known from Hosono--Lian--Takagi--Yau; the claim of originality is the all-m local rank distribution and sharp projective maximum.
General toric divisor-class methods may implicitly cover the calculation without giving the displayed pointwise closed formula.
title: Local divisor-class stratification of projective even-cycle edge varieties
